messages:
maya: heads-up — onboarding for model `atlas-7b-chat` failed in the hf->redwood converter during safetensors merge. stacktrace shows missing shard referenced by index.json
import-bot: import job 2026-06-12T10:13Z started for atlas-7b-chat (rev: main)
maya: here's the error snippet from converter:
```
2026-06-12 10:14:02 ERROR converter: MissingShardError: index.json references shard 'pytorch_model-00002-of-00004.safetensors' but file not found after download
  at hf_downloader.py:fetch_shards(…)
  at converter.py:merge_shards(…)
```
maya: I see only 3 shard files in the download dir (`00000, 00001, 00003`) — 00002 is missing. no 403 in the initial curl logs though.
jonathan: hmm this smells like an auth / retry race. we sometimes see the hub return a newer index.json on retry if revision pinning wasn't used. if the index changed between list and download you can miss a shard.
eli: can you paste the hub api responses? quick check: was the download using a commit hash or branch name?
maya: branch `main` — we used the default behavior (no --revision). logs show a short 401 right before one of the shard GETs: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized` then a successful retry 200 for other files.
sre-bot: detected transient 401s from hf.hub for user token X*** at 2026-06-12T10:13:59Z, rate-limit window reset in 1s.
jonathan: yep, flow is: list index.json -> download shards in parallel -> some shard requests hit transient 401/retry -> downloader retries but may pick a new index.json if it does a fresh list. if that new index no longer references the same file set you end up with holes.
eli: short-term mitigation: downloader should pin the index.json content (checksum) at start and fail if list changes mid-download. long-term: use revision commit hash for deterministic snapshots.
tao: also seen weight key rename issues: even if you get all shards, the converter sometimes fails later because `lm_head` key got renamed to `embed_out` in the HF checkpoint (different export conventions). converter's keymap is too strict.
maya: current conversion run also shows a later error: `KeyError: 'lm_head'` during quantize step. so two issues colliding — missing shard + key rename. fun.
jonathan: for key renames we have a small patch that maps common variants (lm_head, lm_head.bias, output_projection -> embed_out). I can drop the patch as a quick PR.
eli: can we add a validation step after download: 1) ensure set(shard_filenames) == set(index.json["files"]) 2) verify each shard checksum matches index.json SHA256. if mismatch -> retry full download with explicit revision.
maya: agreed. for immediate unblock I re-triggered a manual hf download with `hf_hub_download(model_id="org/atlas-7b-chat", revision="b4a1c2f")` and re-ran converter with `--rename-keys lm_head:embed_out,output_projection:embed_out`. converter completed local run.
jonathan: file a short test case: simulate index.json switching mid-download and assert converter fails fast and logs clear error. also add a test for keymap fallback.
import-bot: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/hf-converter/issues/482 by maya (title: "safetensors shard missing when hub revision not pinned + key rename collision").
maya: thanks. assigning to @jonathan for the keymap PR and @eli for the download validation work. I'll add the failing model to the onboarding triage list so ops won't retry it blind.
tao: minor note — when re-downloading with revision hash we still saw 1 partial 401; downloader retried and completed. hash pin makes outcome deterministic though.
eli: plan: (1) add index pin + checksum verification (2) add retry policy that re-lists only if revision provided (3) augment converter keymap with common renames and allow user-specified mappings via CLI flag `--rename-keys` (implemented in 1h PR)
jonathan: I'll prepare the mapping PR. quick mapping list I used locally: `{"lm_head":"embed_out","lm_head.bias":"embed_out.bias","output_projection":"embed_out"}`
maya: copied. once PRs land I'll re-run onboarding and mark model green.
jonathan: adding small logging improvement too: when missing shards we should print index.json sha and file list so debugging is faster.
sre-bot: scheduled job to re-run failed importer for atlas-7b-chat in 1 hour after PR merge.
maya: perfect. thanks all — saved product from a noisy retry loop. :pray:
eli: follow-up: can someone add the `--no-cache` flag to the onboarding job templates? that'll avoid stale cached listings.
maya: noted, will update template after PRs merge.
tao: +1 for a short postmortem entry (one-paragraph) in /incidents later so infra team knows the pattern.
maya: will draft it after we confirm fix.
